states.rule: Completed historical claims grounded in admitted manuscript/evidence. Never mutate into current data.
Reconstructed historical state; uncertainty and source limits must remain visible.
Durable system relationships grounded in admitted historical/manuscript evidence. May remain readable when no live current value is admitted, but must not be presented as a live metric.
A registered observation target or evidenced directional signal. It does not become CURRENT_DATA or a forecast without dated source admission.
Requires asOfDate, sourceDate, retrievedAt/lastReviewedAt and freshness. STALE data must not present as current.
Derived from admitted inputs; derivation is not an observed fact.
Projection ≠ Prediction. No forecast certainty, guaranteed outcome or future fact.
A valid governed output. Missing evidence must not be hidden or filled by confident inference.

cases: Historical identity/time/linkage may be CANONICAL_HISTORY when grounded; contested granular fields remain UNKNOWN or HISTORICAL_RECONSTRUCTION.
windows: Window membership is historical indexing; causal weighting remains case-scoped and may remain UNKNOWN.
snapshots: Historical snapshots may be CANONICAL_HISTORY; 2026 remains UNKNOWN until current data is admitted. Static visual availability never proves data currency.
dossiers: STRUCTURAL_KNOWLEDGE and HISTORICAL_DERIVATION remain readable when current values are absent.
UNKNOWN must be scoped to the unresolved field and must not blank an otherwise supported dossier.
livedReality: Observed and derived values must remain distinguishable; no universal 0–100 score.
Structural transmission mechanisms may be shown without current metrics when grounded in admitted historical/manuscript evidence.
Missing current values must not collapse a lived-reality card into a placeholder.
projection: 13.84 is CONDITIONAL_PROJECTION only; 13.85 is possibility-space/observation-threshold framing. Projection ≠ Prediction.
runtimePositions: The 48-position registry is STRUCTURAL_KNOWLEDGE, not a deterministic civilization timeline.
A current entity-to-position correspondence is DERIVED_RUNTIME_READOUT and requires admitted evidence.
A transition signal may be OBSERVED_SIGNAL; a future reachable position is CONDITIONAL_PROJECTION only.
One entity may have primary, secondary and UNKNOWN correspondences by subsystem; no forced single global phase.

Capacity, load, alignment, resilience, adaptability, future capacity, external dependency, technology and population are reading dimensions/transition conditions, not the axes that generate the 48 positions.
runtimePositionW6: A dossier observation target is STRUCTURAL_KNOWLEDGE until admitted current evidence supports OBSERVED_SIGNAL.
CURRENT_DATA requires dated provenance, freshness and source admission; structural prose cannot be promoted to CURRENT_DATA.
Runtime-position correspondence is DERIVED_RUNTIME_READOUT and requires human admission.
Observation-threshold crossing is not inferred from one event, one metric or a score; criteria remain explicit and human-governed.
Reachable runtime positions are CONDITIONAL_PROJECTION only and must preserve enabling conditions, closing conditions and UNKNOWN.
